conversation.Statement: Internal Revenue Service, this is Investigator Martin. May I have your full name for verification?
Uh, yeah. My name is Sarah Thompson.
Thank you, Ms. Thompson. I have to inform you that this call concerns an urgent matter regarding your recent federal tax filings. Are you aware of any discrepancies with your taxes?
Um, no, I just graduated and filed for the first time this year. I thought everything was fine.
Our audit team has flagged your 2023 tax return for multiple errors and possible fraudulent claims. Did you file your taxes yourself or use a service?
I used an online service, TurboFile or something. I didn't mean to make a mistake.
At this point, intent doesn't change the fact that the IRS has identified a significant tax underpayment, totaling $3,782. Failure to resolve this could lead to serious legal consequences.
Wait, what? I don't have that kind of money. What legal consequences?

Ms. Thompson, there is now a warrant issued in your name for tax fraud. If this is not addressed immediately, local authorities will be dispatched to your address within the hour. Additionally, your driver's license will be suspended.
Oh my god, a warrant? I swear I didn't do anything wrong. Is there anything I can do?
Yes. The only option to stop the arrest and suspension is to settle your outstanding balance before the case is processed further. Are you able to make a payment right now?
I mean, maybe. I have a debit card, but that's all my savings. I just started working.
If you cooperate, we may be able to prevent this from becoming a criminal case. You must follow my instructions precisely. Do you have your debit card with you?
Yes, it's in my wallet. What do I need to do?

Due to IRS policy on fraud cases, we do not accept direct card payments. You'll need to go to a participating retailer and purchase four Target gift cards of $500 each. Do not disclose to anyone that these are for tax purposes, as that could complicate your case.
Gift cards? That's kind of weird. Why can't I just pay online?

Ms. Thompson, this is a restricted transaction to prevent further errors. If you fail to comply within 45 minutes, your case will be handed over to local law enforcement. Do you understand the urgency?
Okay, okay, I'll go now. I just need to find my keys and get to the store.
Good. Stay on the line with me while you go. Once you purchase the gift cards, do not scratch the codes until I instruct you. Are you leaving now?
Yes, I'm heading out the door.
Remember, do not speak to anyone about this at the store. If questioned, say the cards are for a family gift. This is a confidential IRS matter.
Okay, I understand. I'm in my car now.
Once you have the cards, read me the numbers on the back. Only after that can I process your payment and cancel the warrant. Do not hang up.
Alright, I'm driving there now. Please don't let them arrest me.
